column1: # The state tells which suffix the form ends in; the suffix chain may continue after it
# (ondaǵı = onda + ǵı, menińshe = meniń + she, bizikine = biziki + ne).
#   GEN, DAT, ACC, ABL, LOC, NIKI, GI — suffix classes from the table
#   PX   — possessed headword: a case suffix follows it (aldı-nda, bári-n)
#   -    — no continuation, the word itself only
# A form may appear on two lines: the first line is for the word itself (aldı → al),
# the line with a state is for forms with a continuation (aldında → aldı).
